Subject: Napoleon Bonaparte manifested as the sovereign constellation 'The Emperor Who Reads the Battlefield'. A commanding full-body Napoleon stands on broad imperial steps, one hand resting on a marshal's campaign map table, the other holding a ceremonial sceptre. Recognizable period face, short dark hair, golden laurel crown, white imperial dress, deep crimson velvet mantle edged with white ermine, restrained golden bee embroidery; imperial eagle standard behind him. Inspired by historical imperial regalia documented by Musée de l'Armée, not a copy of an existing painting. Low camera, monumental scale, strong silhouette, face small within a grand composition but expressive and resolute. A circular stone throne and huge columns frame him; far below, ordered ranks of the army and battlefield smoke show his dominion. Warm gold light breaks through storm clouds onto the emperor; charcoal, ivory, antique gold and burgundy. Majestic and intimidating authority, gravity rather than an action pose. Make this a magnificent scene, absolutely not a bust portrait or trading card.

Subject: Yog-Sothoth, the All-in-One and One-in-All, the gate and the key, an unknowable sovereign beyond time and space from Lovecraft's literary cosmic horror. NOT a man or ordinary monster, NOT Cthulhu or a squid face. A colossal connected congregation of unequal iridescent luminous spheres, dark translucent orbs with pale-gold and spectral violet edges, surrounding a vast impossible open gateway suspended above shattered ancient stone terraces. Inside the doorway appear layers of different starfields and epochs. Interlocking angular rings and broken monumental pillars emphasize cosmic order transcending human geometry. Tiny empty stone stairways in the foreground establish overwhelming size; no human protagonist, no readable runes or text. The entity occupies most of the composition, feels sovereign, solemn and terrifying, not a splash of colorful bubbles. One clear radiant spatial focal point, restrained near-black indigo, oxidized teal, bone white, antique gold and sparse violet; luminosity built from stepped bands of pixel color, not soft bloom. Wide low-angle scene with the full gate and meaningful empty darkness to frame it, awe and absolute authority over reality. No headshot, no card layout.
